examples.en: Italy is a long peninsula that extends into the Mediterranean Sea.
examples.zh: 義大利是一個伸入地中海的狹長半島。

examples.en: We rented a small cabin on the peninsula for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我們在半島上租了一間小木屋度週末。

examples.en: This peninsula is famous for its beautiful beaches and fresh seafood.
examples.zh: 這個半島以美麗的海灘和新鮮的海鮮聞名。

senses.zh: 棲息；坐在邊緣；坐落高處

examples.en: A small bird perched on the branch outside my window.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥棲息在我窗外的樹枝上。

examples.en: She perched on the edge of the desk and began to talk.
examples.zh: 她坐在書桌邊緣開始說話。

examples.en: The old house perches on a hill above the village.
examples.zh: 那棟老房子坐落在村莊上方的山丘上。

examples.en: The parrot jumped from its perch to my shoulder.
examples.zh: 鸚鵡從棲木跳到我的肩膀上。

examples.en: From his perch on the ladder, he could see the whole yard.
examples.zh: 從他在梯子上的位置，他可以看見整個院子。

examples.en: We cooked the perch we caught in the lake for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們把在湖裡釣到的鱸魚煮來當晚餐。

examples.en: The sailors were in great peril when the storm hit.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來襲時，水手們身陷極大的危險。

examples.en: The rescue team saved the hikers from peril.
examples.zh: 救援隊把登山客從險境中救了出來。

examples.en: Parents must teach children about the perils of crossing busy roads.
examples.zh: 家長必須教孩子了解穿越繁忙道路的危險。

examples.en: Many plants will perish if the weather stays this cold.
examples.zh: 如果天氣持續這麼冷，許多植物會死亡。

examples.en: The ancient city perished after a terrible earthquake.
examples.zh: 這座古城在一場可怕的地震後毀滅了。

examples.en: Fresh fruit will perish quickly if you leave it in the sun.
examples.zh: 新鮮水果如果放在太陽下，很快就會腐壞。

examples.en: Cell phones are permissible in the hallway but not in class.
examples.zh: 走廊上可以使用手機，但課堂上不行。

examples.en: Is it permissible to bring my own food into the theater?
examples.zh: 可以自己帶食物進電影院嗎？

examples.en: The maximum permissible speed on this road is 50 kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 這條路的最高容許車速是每小時五十公里。

examples.en: If you persevere, you will eventually learn to play the piano.
examples.zh: 只要你堅持不懈，最後一定能學會彈鋼琴。

examples.en: She persevered despite many failures and finally won the contest.
examples.zh: 儘管多次失敗，她仍堅持下去，最後贏得了比賽。

examples.en: We must persevere with our study plan even when it gets difficult.
examples.zh: 即使變得困難，我們也必須持續努力執行讀書計畫。

examples.en: Her persistence paid off when she passed the exam.
examples.zh: 她的毅力有了回報，她通過了考試。

examples.en: Learning a language takes time and persistence.
examples.zh: 學習語言需要時間和堅持。

examples.en: The persistence of the noise made it hard to sleep.
examples.zh: 噪音一直持續，讓人很難入睡。

examples.en: She is a persistent student who never gives up.
examples.zh: 她是個堅持不懈、從不放棄的學生。

examples.en: Persistent rain has delayed the opening of the new park.
examples.zh: 連日不停的雨延後了新公園的開幕。

examples.en: The company received persistent complaints about the slow service.
examples.zh: 公司不斷收到對緩慢服務的抱怨。

examples.en: Petroleum is used to make gasoline and plastic.
examples.zh: 石油可用來製造汽油和塑膠。

examples.en: The country earns most of its money from exporting petroleum.
examples.zh: 這個國家的收入大多來自出口石油。

examples.en: Prices of petroleum products rose again this month.
examples.zh: 本月石油製品的價格又上漲了。

examples.en: The pharmacist explained how to take the medicine.
examples.zh: 藥師解釋了這種藥該怎麼服用。

examples.en: My aunt works as a pharmacist at a hospital in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在台北一家醫院擔任藥師。

examples.en: Ask the pharmacist if the two medicines are safe to take together.
examples.zh: 請問藥師這兩種藥可不可以一起吃。

examples.en: There is a pharmacy next to the supermarket.
examples.zh: 超市旁邊有一間藥局。

examples.en: I picked up my medicine at the pharmacy after school.
examples.zh: 放學後我到藥局領藥。

examples.en: He is studying pharmacy at a university in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 他在高雄一所大學主修藥學。

examples.en: A pickpocket stole her wallet on the crowded train.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的火車上，扒手偷走了她的皮夾。

examples.en: Watch out for pickpockets when you visit busy tourist areas.
examples.zh: 到熱鬧的觀光區時要小心扒手。

examples.en: The police caught the pickpocket near the night market.
examples.zh: 警方在夜市附近抓到了那名扒手。

examples.en: I woke up with a big pimple on my nose.
examples.zh: 我一覺醒來，鼻子上長了一顆大痘痘。

examples.en: Don't squeeze your pimples, or they may leave marks.
examples.zh: 不要擠痘痘，不然可能會留下痘疤。

examples.en: Teenagers often get a pimple or two before big events.
examples.zh: 青少年常在重要場合前冒出一兩顆痘痘。

examples.en: She pinched my arm to wake me up.
examples.zh: 她捏了我的手臂把我叫醒。

examples.en: These shoes pinch my toes when I walk fast.
examples.zh: 我走快的時候，這雙鞋會夾痛我的腳趾。

examples.en: He pinched his nose because of the bad smell.
examples.zh: 他因為難聞的氣味而捏住鼻子。

examples.en: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
examples.zh: 在湯裡加一小撮鹽。

examples.en: She gave the dough a gentle pinch to seal the edges.
examples.zh: 她輕輕捏了麵糰一下，把邊緣封好。

examples.en: In a pinch, you can use milk instead of cream.
examples.zh: 緊要關頭時，你可以用牛奶代替鮮奶油。

examples.en: The city lost thousands of people to the plague in the 1300s.
examples.zh: 這座城市在十四世紀因鼠疫失去了數千人。

examples.en: A plague of insects ruined the farmers' crops.
examples.zh: 大量害蟲毀了農民的作物。

examples.en: Historians study how the plague spread across Europe.
examples.zh: 歷史學家研究鼠疫如何傳遍歐洲。

examples.en: Back pain has plagued him for years.
examples.zh: 背痛困擾了他好幾年。

examples.en: Delays and technical problems plagued the project.
examples.zh: 延誤和技術問題一直困擾著這項專案。

examples.en: Mosquitoes plague the campsite every summer despite efforts to control them.
examples.zh: 儘管已採取防治措施，蚊子每年夏天仍困擾著這個露營區。

examples.en: My grandfather worked on a tea plantation in Nantou.
examples.zh: 我祖父曾在南投的一座茶葉種植園工作。

examples.en: The banana plantation covers hundreds of hectares.
examples.zh: 這座香蕉種植園占地數百公頃。

examples.en: Workers on the coffee plantation pick the beans by hand.
examples.zh: 咖啡種植園的工人用手採收咖啡豆。

examples.en: Shakespeare is the most famous playwright in English history.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞是英國歷史上最有名的劇作家。

examples.en: The young playwright wrote a play about school life.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的劇作家寫了一齣關於校園生活的戲。

examples.en: Our drama club invited a playwright to talk about writing.
examples.zh: 我們的戲劇社邀請了一位劇作家來談寫作。

examples.en: The farmer pulled the plow across the field with two oxen.
examples.zh: 農夫用兩頭牛拉著犁穿過田野。

examples.en: In the old days, people used a wooden plow to prepare the soil.
examples.zh: 以前的人用木犁來整地。

examples.en: A snow plow cleared the road early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一早除雪車就把道路清乾淨了。

examples.en: Farmers plow their fields before they plant rice.
examples.zh: 農夫在種稻之前先犁田。

examples.en: The tractor plowed the field in just two hours.
examples.zh: 曳引機只花了兩小時就把田犁好了。

examples.en: The ship plowed through the rough waves.
examples.zh: 這艘船破浪前進。

examples.en: He stayed in the hospital for a week because of pneumonia.
examples.zh: 他因為肺炎住院一週。

examples.en: Pneumonia is more dangerous for babies and older people.
examples.zh: 肺炎對嬰兒和老年人更危險。

examples.en: The doctor said her cough might be a sign of pneumonia.
examples.zh: 醫生說她咳嗽可能是肺炎的徵兆。

examples.en: Polar bears live in the Arctic region.
examples.zh: 北極熊生活在北極地區。

examples.en: Scientists are studying how polar ice affects the sea level.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究極地冰層如何影響海平面。

examples.en: Temperatures in the polar regions can drop far below zero.
examples.zh: 極地地區的氣溫可能降到遠低於零度。

examples.en: She sat by the window and pondered her future.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗邊，思考自己的未來。

examples.en: I need some time to ponder your offer.
examples.zh: 我需要一些時間仔細考慮你的提議。

examples.en: The students pondered the question before they answered.
examples.zh: 學生們在回答前先仔細想了想這個問題。

examples.en: Millions of people populate the island's large cities.
examples.zh: 數百萬人居住在這座島的大城市裡。

examples.en: The area was first populated by farmers about 500 years ago.
examples.zh: 這個地區大約在五百年前首次有農民居住。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to populate the chart with the survey results.
examples.zh: 老師要我們把調查結果填入圖表。

examples.en: Good posture can help prevent back pain.
examples.zh: 良好的姿勢有助於預防背痛。

examples.en: Check your posture while you work at the computer.
examples.zh: 用電腦工作時，要留意自己的姿勢。

examples.en: The company changed its posture on pricing after hearing from customers.
examples.zh: 公司在聽取顧客意見後，改變了價格方面的立場。

examples.en: This potent cough syrup can make you sleepy.
examples.zh: 這種強效咳嗽糖漿可能讓你想睡。

examples.en: Social media can be a potent tool for small businesses.
examples.zh: 社群媒體對小型企業來說可能是強大的工具。

examples.en: Her speech was a potent reminder of the importance of kindness.
examples.zh: 她的演講有力地提醒了大家善良的重要。

examples.en: The pastor preaches every Sunday morning at our church.
examples.zh: 牧師每週日早上在我們的教會講道。

examples.en: My brother always preaches about saving money but spends it all.
examples.zh: 我哥哥總愛說教要存錢，自己卻把錢都花光。

examples.en: The doctor preached the benefits of regular exercise to his patients.
examples.zh: 醫生向病人宣導規律運動的好處。

examples.en: A short video will precede the main speech.
examples.zh: 一段短片會在主要演講之前播放。

examples.en: Dark clouds often precede a heavy rainstorm.
examples.zh: 烏雲通常出現在大雨之前。

examples.en: The letter A precedes B in the alphabet.
examples.zh: 在字母表中，A 排在 B 的前面。

examples.en: If we let one student leave early, it may set a precedent.
examples.zh: 如果我們讓一位學生提早離開，可能會開先例。

examples.en: Such a result has no precedent in our school's history.
examples.zh: 這樣的結果在我們學校的歷史上沒有先例。

examples.en: The judge followed the precedent set by an earlier court.
examples.zh: 法官遵循了先前法院所確立的先例。

examples.en: The watch was made with great precision.
examples.zh: 這支手錶以極高的精確度製成。

examples.en: Surgeons need precision and steady hands to perform complicated operations.
examples.zh: 外科醫師進行複雜手術時，需要精準的操作和穩定的雙手。

examples.en: The machine can measure small objects with remarkable precision.
examples.zh: 這台機器能以驚人的準確度測量小型物體。

examples.en: The new manager is friendlier than her predecessor.
examples.zh: 新經理比她的前任更親切。

examples.en: This phone is faster than its predecessor.
examples.zh: 這支手機比前一代更快。

examples.en: The company's predecessor was a small shop opened in 1950.
examples.zh: 這家公司的前身是一九五〇年開的一間小店。

examples.en: Scientists found prehistoric tools in a cave near the sea.
examples.zh: 科學家在海邊附近的洞穴裡發現了史前工具。

examples.en: We saw a prehistoric skeleton at the science museum.
examples.zh: 我們在科學博物館看到一具史前的骨骸。

examples.en: Cave paintings show how prehistoric people hunted.
examples.zh: 洞穴壁畫顯示史前人類如何狩獵。

examples.en: The premiere of the new movie will be held in Taipei tonight.
examples.zh: 這部新電影的首映會今晚在台北舉行。

examples.en: Fans waited outside the theater for the premiere.
examples.zh: 影迷們在戲院外等候首映。

examples.en: Tickets for the premiere of the school play sold out quickly.
examples.zh: 校內戲劇首演的票很快就賣完了。

examples.en: The new drama will premiere on Friday night.
examples.zh: 這部新影集將在週五晚上首播。

examples.en: Her documentary premiered at a film festival in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 她的紀錄片在東京的影展首次放映。

examples.en: The orchestra will premiere a new piece this spring.
examples.zh: 管弦樂團今年春天將首演一首新曲。

examples.en: The mayor will preside at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 市長將主持開幕典禮。

examples.en: Our principal presides over the weekly staff meeting.
examples.zh: 校長主持每週的教職員會議。

examples.en: The senior member presided at the dinner and welcomed the guests.
examples.zh: 資深會員主持了晚宴並歡迎賓客。

examples.en: The university has great prestige around the world.
examples.zh: 這所大學在全世界享有很高的聲望。

examples.en: Winning the national prize brought prestige to our school.
examples.zh: 贏得全國大獎為我們學校帶來了聲譽。

examples.en: Some people buy expensive watches for prestige.
examples.zh: 有些人為了聲望而買昂貴的手錶。

examples.en: Regular check-ups are an important preventive measure.
examples.zh: 定期健康檢查是重要的預防措施。

examples.en: Preventive care can save families a lot of money later.
examples.zh: 預防性的照護日後能為家庭省下很多錢。

examples.en: The city took preventive steps to avoid flooding before the typhoon.
examples.zh: 市府在颱風來臨前採取預防措施以避免淹水。

examples.en: The museum keeps a priceless painting in a glass case.
examples.zh: 博物館把一幅無價的畫作放在玻璃櫃裡。

examples.en: Time with my grandparents is priceless to me.
examples.zh: 和祖父母相處的時光對我來說是無價的。

examples.en: The old photo is priceless because it shows my family many years ago.
examples.zh: 這張舊照片非常珍貴，因為它記錄了我家多年前的樣子。

examples.en: The government plans to privatize the railway company.
examples.zh: 政府計畫將這家鐵路公司民營化。

examples.en: Some people think it is a mistake to privatize water services.
examples.zh: 有些人認為將供水服務民營化是個錯誤。

examples.en: The airline was privatized in the 1990s.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司在一九九〇年代民營化了。

examples.en: Scientists sent a space probe to study Mars.
examples.zh: 科學家發射太空探測器來研究火星。

examples.en: The dentist used a thin probe to check my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙醫用一支細探針檢查我的牙齒。

examples.en: The school started a probe into the missing money.
examples.zh: 學校對遺失的款項展開調查。

examples.en: The reporter probed deeper into the cause of the delay.
examples.zh: 記者更深入調查延誤的原因。

examples.en: The teacher probed gently to find out why Tom was upset.
examples.zh: 老師委婉地探問，想知道湯姆為什麼不開心。

examples.en: Engineers will probe the ocean floor with a robot.
examples.zh: 工程師將用機器人探查海底。

examples.en: A long procession of cars followed the bride's car.
examples.zh: 一長列車輛跟在新娘的車後面。

examples.en: The temple procession moved slowly through the market street.
examples.zh: 廟會的遊行隊伍緩緩穿過市場街道。

examples.en: Children in costumes joined the festival procession.
examples.zh: 穿著服裝的孩子們加入了慶典的遊行隊伍。

examples.en: Her proficiency in English helped her get the job.
examples.zh: 她的英語能力幫助她得到了這份工作。

examples.en: You must show proficiency in math to enter this class.
examples.zh: 你必須展現數學方面的熟練程度才能進入這個班級。

examples.en: The test measures your proficiency in speaking and listening.
examples.zh: 這項測驗衡量你在口說和聽力方面的能力。

examples.en: There is a strict prohibition on smoking in the building.
examples.zh: 這棟大樓內對吸菸有嚴格的禁令。

examples.en: The school announced a prohibition on bringing phones to exams.
examples.zh: 學校宣布禁止攜帶手機進考場。

examples.en: Many people did not agree with the prohibition of fishing in the lake.
examples.zh: 許多人不同意禁止在湖裡釣魚的規定。

examples.en: Strong wind propelled the small boat across the lake.
examples.zh: 強風推著小船橫越湖面。

examples.en: Her hard work propelled her to the top of the class.
examples.zh: 她的努力推動她登上班上第一名。

examples.en: The engine burns fuel to propel the rocket into space.
examples.zh: 引擎燃燒燃料，將火箭推向太空。

examples.en: He writes poems, but his prose is also beautiful.
examples.zh: 他寫詩，但他的散文也很優美。

examples.en: The novel is written in simple, clear prose.
examples.zh: 這部小說的文字簡單清楚。

examples.en: Students often find poetry harder to understand than prose.
examples.zh: 學生常覺得詩比散文更難懂。

examples.en: The company was prosecuted for dumping waste in the river.
examples.zh: 該公司因為把廢棄物倒入河中而遭到起訴。

examples.en: Anyone who steals from the store will be prosecuted.
examples.zh: 任何在店裡偷東西的人都會被起訴。

examples.en: It is the prosecutor's job to prosecute people who break the law.
examples.zh: 檢察官的工作是起訴違法的人。

examples.en: The school held a tour for prospective students and their parents.
examples.zh: 學校為未來的學生和家長舉辦了參觀活動。

examples.en: We met a prospective buyer who wanted to see the apartment.
examples.zh: 我們見了一位想看公寓的潛在買家。

examples.en: The company is talking to several prospective partners.
examples.zh: 公司正與幾位潛在的合作夥伴洽談。

examples.en: The engineers built a prototype of the electric scooter.
examples.zh: 工程師們製作了電動機車的原型。

examples.en: The first prototype was too heavy, so the team redesigned it.
examples.zh: 第一個原型太重，所以團隊重新設計了它。

examples.en: Students presented a prototype of their app to the judges.
examples.zh: 學生們向評審展示了他們應用程式的原型。

examples.en: The provincial capital is a busy city of three million people.
examples.zh: 省會是個擁有三百萬人口的繁忙城市。

examples.en: The provincial government built a new highway.
examples.zh: 省政府興建了一條新公路。

examples.en: She grew up in a small provincial town.
examples.zh: 她在一個地方小鎮長大。

examples.en: The team set up a provisional office until the building was ready.
examples.zh: 在大樓完工前，團隊先設置了臨時辦公室。

examples.en: He got a provisional offer, which still needs final approval.
examples.zh: 他收到一份暫定的錄取通知，仍需最後核准。

examples.en: The provisional schedule may change next week.
examples.zh: 暫定的時間表下週可能會更動。

examples.en: She decided to study psychiatry after working in a hospital.
examples.zh: 她在醫院工作後，決定攻讀精神醫學。

examples.en: The hospital has a special department of psychiatry.
examples.zh: 這家醫院設有專門的精神科。

examples.en: Advances in psychiatry have helped many people with depression.
examples.zh: 精神醫學的進步幫助了許多憂鬱症患者。

examples.en: The woman claims to have psychic powers.
examples.zh: 那位女士聲稱自己有通靈的能力。

examples.en: The movie is about a girl with psychic abilities.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一位擁有通靈能力的女孩。

examples.en: Are you psychic? You always know what I am thinking!
examples.zh: 你會通靈嗎？你總是知道我在想什麼！

examples.en: A psychic told her she would travel to Europe.
examples.zh: 一位靈媒告訴她，她將前往歐洲旅行。

examples.en: Some people visit a psychic when they are unsure about their future.
examples.zh: 有些人對未來感到不確定時會去找靈媒。

examples.en: The psychic closed her eyes and held the stranger's hand.
examples.zh: 靈媒閉上眼睛，握住陌生人的手。

examples.en: The club made posters to publicize the school concert.
examples.zh: 社團製作海報來宣傳學校音樂會。

examples.en: The company publicized its new product on social media.
examples.zh: 公司在社群媒體上宣傳了新產品。

examples.en: She did not want to publicize her private life.
examples.zh: 她不想公開自己的私生活。
